aberteos.de is live.

A crypto trading bot for Bybit and Binance (spot, futures, stock and commodity perpetuals) that you run yourself in Docker on your PC, server or NAS. Your API keys stay on your machine.

Free beta, every feature included:
https://www.aberteos.de/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch-2026-11

Post written with AI help; screenshot uses demo data.
